title: before and after 5 months of part time progress - two man team
author: Glittering-Chef-4914

comments.author: Dear-Personality-299
comments.body: Looks better and better! Interested in the progress! Keep up!

comments.author: edoc422
comments.body: How did you make the attack animations? I have trying to use wan2.2 but it’s seem like it has really tough time with low frame counts.

replies.author: Glittering-Chef-4914
replies.body: There is no frames, we are only switching to a new pose. I used nano banana. We use VFX and motion blur to help make it look all smooth. But there's literally only an idle pose and an attack pose. No animation frames

replies.author: DreamNotDeferred
replies.body: Very smart. Been trying to figure out animations with AI too. Elegant solution.

comments.author: ArtArtArt123456
comments.body: Curious how the 2nd person came to the project and what their focus is. Or were they part of it from the get go?

replies.author: Glittering-Chef-4914
replies.body: They are a programmer and have been with me at the beginning. I do everything else. I've know them for several years they worked on another game with me.

comments.author: NeoDragonCP
comments.body: That looks much better now. I love the effects for the attacks and swapping in party members. Did AI generate those effects or how did you make them?

replies.author: Glittering-Chef-4914
replies.body: They are from fab marketplace or I made them myself. They are Niagara systems

comments.author: 3tich
comments.body: We're you going for metal slug art style or was that unintentional

comments.author: marictdude22
comments.body:
The animations are really well done, I think the backgrounds and character art could use some adjustment personally

1. Background looks okay but has kind of an AI sheen due to lack of attention to detail, like this boat-tree 

https://preview.redd.it/nrkh9qxn0bzf1.png?width=460&format=png&auto=webp&s=54b583375451282643e764379c6a5076133efbe8

  
2. The characters themselves have the piss filter, which might be able to be just color corrected

I also think the character art style does not match the background art style.  
Good luck on your game looks fun!

replies.author: Glittering-Chef-4914
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback!

The backgrounds are with an old SDXL. I have to update them but haven't figured out what app I want to use to do it because I need control net and most closed source models that are good don't have control net. If you have a suggestion I'm all ears.

The characters are being completely redone, still a WIP correcting the proportions and unifying colors. The piss filter was already removed in the video you see, unless you're talking about the before video

https://preview.redd.it/412vzc42lczf1.png?width=2439&format=png&auto=webp&s=7b813a39e3256d0ea30e7e960a5b5b393d717854

replies.author: marictdude22
replies.body:
I see so the backgrounds are being generated on device? That does make it a bit more tricky. I suggest using a fine tune of SDXL if you arn't already (you can find a ton on civitAI), there are ones that have much more consistent styling.  
  
They are the same arch so plugging them into the pre-existing controlnet flow shouldn't be too hard (not that I know how you are doing this in the first place).
